title: Aale aba mein
body:
aale aba mein matame shere khuda hai aaj
roze widae hazrate mushkil kusha hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid mein ibne muljim e maloon ki taygh se
zakhmi jo hogaya tha usi ki qaza hai aaj
aale aba mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shiyon udao khaak gareban phaad do
uryan jina mein farqe rasoole khuda hai aaj
aale aba mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat ke gird rote hai baara pisar khade
jin ko yateem daure falak ne kiya hai aaj
aale aba mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pursa do aaj ahmed e mursal ko bhai ka
nayeb rasoole haq ka jahan se utha hai aaj
aale aba mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiq jahan mein hashr ke aasaar hai ayan
maahe siyam maahe moharram hua hai aaj
aale aba mein...
author: Sadiq
